help.text: Open SmartView with the instance link (globe icon). Pages and tiles are set up in the app itself (✎ at the top right). For push notifications on the iPhone install the certificate once: page /zertifikat.

https.label: HTTPS with own certificate (needed for push notifications)

publicHost.label: Address of the ioBroker server (optional)
publicHost.help: Empty = detected automatically. Also used for the certificate.

accessKey.label: Access key (optional)
accessKey.help: If set, SmartView must be opened once with ?key=... per device

allowEdit.label: Allow editing in the app
allowEdit.help: Switch off when the layout is finished, so nobody changes it by accident
